svg.text: Dariush Talā'ī's Theory of Dāngs: 3-Layer Decoupled Architecture
Decoupling Source Heuristics (~20¢ Grid) · Pure Rational Models (498.05¢ Pure 4th) · Empirical Master Consensus
1. Dāng-e Shūr (Root of Shūr, Dashti, Navā, Abū’atā, Afshārī)
Pattern: Neutral 2nd (N) + Neutral 2nd (N) + Greater Whole Tone (T+)
• L3 (Empirical): 12-master consensus Reᵏ = +138.7¢ [Cat A: Saba 129.0¢, Shahnazi 128.0¢, Safvat 127.5¢; Qajar Borumand Navā limma = 90.2¢]
Pattern: Whole Tone (T) + Whole Tone (T) + Semitone (S) · Conjunct do-dāngi (G-A-B-C + C-D-E-F)
• L3 (Empirical): 13-master consensus Re = +201.5¢, Mi = +400.8¢ (individual range 386.6–414.7¢; 6 masters cluster near 81/64: Borumand 414.7¢, Ebadi 412.0¢)
Pattern: Neutral 2nd (N) + Augmented 2nd (A) + Semitone (S) · Symmetrical pairs on Do and Sol
• L3 (Empirical): 12-master consensus Reᵏ = +138.7¢, Mi = +402.3¢, Fa = +497.1¢ · Aug 2nd span = 263.6¢
4. Dāng-e Esfahān / Minor (Kernel of Bayāt-e Esfahān) & Dāng-e Navā
Pattern: Whole Tone (T) + Semitone (S) + Whole Tone (T) · In S2 p. 92, Talā'ī lists 4th dāng as Navā (200+80+220¢)
• L3 (Empirical): Measured in Bayāt-e Esfahān: Re = +201.2¢, Mi♭ = +294.5¢, Fa = +497.8¢ · Coupled with Upper Chahārgāh on Sol
5. Superimposed Setār String 1 Architecture: Splitting the "Phantom Fret" into 39/32 vs 27/22
• Mathematical & Organological Resolution of the "Phantom Fret" Conundrum:
1. Transposition Model (39/32 = 342.5¢): If the Shūr dāng [1, 13/12, 32/27, 4/3] is shifted literally to Re (9/8), the 2nd degree falls at 9/8 × 13/12 = 39/32 (342.5¢).
2. Physical Neck Fret (27/22 = 354.5¢): Ancient Wosṭā-Zalzal fret (9/8 × 12/11 = 27/22) preserved on the Setār neck since Al-Fārābī (c. 950).

3. Empirical Proof from 1,282 Audio Strikes: Measured Segāh Mūyeh sits at +352.7¢ — within 1.85¢ of Zalzal (27/22), and 10.22¢ away from 39/32! Iranian masters retune this fret to Zalzal rather than playing a literal transposition.

Layer 1 (Source): Talā'ī's ~20¢ grid (500¢ sum) captures pedagogical morphology · Layer 2 (Rational): Pure mathematical ratios span exact pure 4th (498.05¢) · Layer 3 (Empirical): Acoustic pitch peaks confirm physical fretting traditions.
